params.command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$raw=Get-Content 'C:\HeavenServices\services.json' -Raw
$data=$raw | ConvertFrom-Json
[pscustomobject]@{
  type=$data.GetType().FullName
  count=@($data).Count
  names=@($data | ForEach-Object {$_.name})
  workerFabricMatches=@($data | Where-Object {$_.name -eq 'Heaven Worker Fabric'}).Count
} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 -Compress
